# Edgematic

Accelerate Physical AI Development with SiMa.ai’s Edgematic on AWS Marketplace — a no-code, visual platform for building, testing, and deploying AI/ML pipelines on edge devices, ideal for developers with or without ML or embedded systems expertise.

#### Create

Instantly evaluate model performance—Throughput, Latency, Power—on SiMa.ai’s cloud-hosted MLSoC boards. Powered by AWS and FTR-aligned, Edgematic offers enterprise-grade security with full data privacy and control.

#### Evaluate

Evaluate models and applications in minutes using our Performance Visualizer on a cloud-hosted SiMa device—run your own project or start with a template.

#### Select

Explore app ideas with our rich catalog of models, plugins, and applications—object detection, segmentation, anomaly detection, classification, and more.

#### Develop

Build optimized apps in a low-code environment with our Gstreamer backend. Import models, data, videos, tweak plugins, or create your own in our IDE.

#### Deploy

Seamlessly deploy models or pipelines to our cloud MLSoC board to measure KPIs like Throughput, Latency, and Power. Visually inspect results and analyze per-plugin performance. Download pipelines anytime for offline use.

#### Optimize

Take full control of your app—edit plugins, add custom logs, and monitor in real time. Diagnose issues fast and run system commands for deep performance insights.
